label: April 2, 2025
changes_html:
About This Vintage

This is a historical reconstruction of The Budget Lab's "Where We Stand: The Fiscal, Economic, and Distributional Effects of All U.S. Tariffs Enacted in 2025 Through April 2" report, restructured to match the current interactive's data format. This report captured tariff policy immediately following the April 2 “Liberation Day” tariff announcement. The “April 2 Announcement Only” scenario models the April 2nd action in isolation, without the other tariffs already in effect earlier in 2025 or any foreign retaliation. The “All 2025 Tariffs to Date” scenario models the April 2nd action stacked together with every other US tariff enacted so far in 2025 (China, Canada, Mexico, autos, steel & aluminum) and all foreign retaliation announced as of publication.

April 2 Announcement Only

This section presents projected effects as of April 2, 2025, under the April 2 Announcement Only scenario. Estimated impacts are measured against a January 2025 tariff-policy baseline.

spec.title: Appendix. April 2nd Tariff Rates
spec.subtitle: As announced by the White House.

figures.body_html: Country-by-country tariff rates as announced by the White House on April 2, 2025: the tariff rate attributed to each country ('Tariffs Charged to the U.S.A.') and the discounted reciprocal tariff rate the US applied in response. This appendix is specific to the April 2nd announcement and is not duplicated under the All 2025 Tariffs to Date scenario.

spec.title: US Average Effective Tariff Rate Since 1790
spec.subtitle: Customs duty revenue as a percentage of goods imports.
spec.source: Historical Statistics of the United States Ea424-434, Monthly Treasury Statement, Bureau of Economic Analysis, The Budget Lab analysis.

series_labels.current_average: Current average effective rate (April 2 Announcement Only)

figures.body_html: The US average effective tariff rate since 1790, with the current (April 2, 2025) average effective rate under the April 2 Announcement Only scenario shown for reference.
figures.note: No direct analogue in the reference (2025-10-30) vintage structure; included as an additional figure.

spec.title: Commodity Price Effects
spec.subtitle: Percent change to price level.
spec.source: GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: Percent change in producer/consumer prices by commodity under the April 2 Announcement Only scenario, overall and split between domestically-produced and imported goods. The published report charted only a subset of the largest movers; this data file includes all commodities.

spec.title: Short-Run Distributional Effects of 2025 Tariffs
spec.subtitle: Tariff burden by household income decile, post-substitution.
spec.source: GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], Census, BLS, BEA, The Budget Lab analysis.
spec.notes: Decile 1 was not published in this release and is omitted.

figures.body_html: The short-run tariff burden by household income decile under the April 2 Announcement Only scenario, as a share of after-tax income and in dollars per household. Values are negative by convention. Decile 1 was not published in the original release.

spec.title: U.S. Real GDP Level Effects of 2025 Tariffs to Date
spec.subtitle: Percentage point change against baseline.
spec.source: S&P Global, GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], GTAP-RD, The Budget Lab analysis.

figures.body_html: The projected path of real GDP relative to a no-new-tariffs baseline, by quarter, under the April 2 Announcement Only scenario.

spec.title: Long-Run Change in Real GDP Level from 2025 Tariffs
spec.subtitle: Percentage point change, by trading partner.
spec.source: GTAP v7 [Corong et al (2017)], The Budget Lab analysis.
spec.notes: FTROW = countries with a comprehensive free trade agreement with the US. ROW = all other countries. Only country-level effects were published in this release; no sector-level breakdown is available for this vintage.

figures.body_html: The long-run change in real GDP under the April 2 Announcement Only scenario, by trading partner. No sector-level breakdown was published in this release.
